outcome: no prolonged length of hospital stay
living well and freeing of disease and sequelae
cohort: A 70-year-old woman with early-stage endometrioid endometrial cancer and extensive abdominal adhesions secondary to a previous complicated cesarean section and bladder rupture.
finding: An ultra-mini wound assisted laparoscopic surgery can be successfully applied in women with extensive and widespread abdominal adhesions without increasing adverse events or prolonging the length of hospital stay.
mod_finding: The ultra-mini wound technique was successfully applied to manage extensive abdominal adhesions that were secondary to a previous complicated cesarean section (C/S).
